why: The card asks which beats the demo covers today, so nobody reads the manifest as a promise about the game. A beat is covered when the recording shows its own action; partial when the build shows part of it or a stand-in; not_reachable when the recording cannot show it in 71 s. The build has four rooms (rm_pp_boot, rm_pp_title, rm_pp_ship and rm_pp_drive, the last of which is reachable only with PP_DRIVE_ROOM set and is not on the route), and PP_NEW_GAME_ROOM is rm_pp_ship (game/scripts/pp_config/pp_config.gml:172).
not_reachable_why: The recording holds one route step on purpose (card DEMO-WALK): data/slice.json hands the crawl to the drive scene drive_to_southampton, which plays on the drive_m4_corridor map, spends 10,680 steps of waits and pages twelve captions that each wait for a press, so it cannot fit a 71 s recording and the script sets PP_ROUTE_HOLD=drive instead. That leaves rm_pp_ship's own map standing, which is the room this video walks. Beats 8 to 19 are therefore out of this recording rather than out of the build: the scene and the corridor map exist. Beats 20 to 25 need the quay gate, the boarding scene and a room that spawns the tutorial fight, and no room in this build spawns an encounter.

beats.title: Title attract: logo, moon, storm cloud, one lightning flash, loops until START
beats.evidence: 10 s of the attract are recorded from the start of the file to the first Enter; the flash is drawn from the seeded stream PP_TITLE_FLASH_SEED = 20261021 (game/scripts/pp_title/pp_title.gml:99, :244), which data/demo/run_001.json pins

beats.title: PRESS START, menu, NEW GAME confirmed
beats.evidence: two Enters 1.5 s apart: the first opens the menu on NEW GAME, the second starts the intro; the game's own 'PP title: intro started' line is the proof the menu took it

beats.title: Fade to black, star field, sickle and bolt constellations
beats.evidence: the note at step 1140 waits on the game's own intro line, so the fade and the stars are on screen when the recording plays through them

beats.title: Crawl beats 1 to 2 (the gods forgotten)
beats.evidence: no key is pressed on the crawl on purpose: a confirm finishes it (pp_title_step_intro, game/scripts/pp_title/pp_title.gml), so the crawl plays at its own pace for the recording

beats.title: Crawl beats 3 to 4 (the four who do not know)
beats.evidence: the run holds with no key from step 1500 to step 2340, which is 14 s of crawl text at the game's own reveal speed (data/intro_text.json, 258 characters over 6 beats); e05 marks the start of the hold and e06 sits inside it

beats.title: Crawl beats 5 to 6 (entropy, Southampton, October) and hold
beats.evidence: the recording runs through the last crawl beat and the hold before the transition; the transition itself is the game's own line, caught by event e08 at the next beat

beats.title: Fade in on Big Ben at night, camera pans down to the street
beats.evidence: the title's own 240 step drive and the fade play between the crawl and the room change, which is 4 s against the beat sheet's 10 s for this beat and 178 s across beats 7 to 19 (tools/capture_title.py, the SHIP_DRIVE_WAIT_S note: 'NEW GAME's 240 step drive (4 s at 60 steps) and the fade')

beats.evidence: one room (rm_pp_ship, game/rooms/rm_pp_ship/rm_pp_ship.yy) with eight Right presses a second apart, which is the same walk the ship capture uses (tools/capture_title.py, SHIP_WALK_STEPS = 8), not the three room corridor. The game log of the 2026-10-26 take carries eight 'PP audio: footstep played' lines against the eight presses (output/demo/demo-talk-2026-10-26_verify.json, footsteps 8), so the presses reached the walker. The confirm at e18 lands on the sailor data/maps/all.json now places at 11,7 of ship_small, one tile ahead of the tile the eight step walk stops on, and the press opens his box: the game log carries 'PP dialogue: talk_navy_sailor with navy_sailor on ship_small 11,7' after the footstep lines, then seven 'text_blip_b played' lines as the line types (card t_11f6a125), and the same take's verify file holds failures []. The beat stays partial rather than covered, because this is one room of the three the beat sheet asks for and no third of the corridor exists yet

summary.note: 24 of the 32 beats are unreachable in this build. The demo is honest as a 73.5 s video of the slice and must not be described as a 15 minute run until the S3 to S6 rooms land.
